item.summary: test(ui-e2e): scale Control UI wait budget for loaded CI runners (#123623) ui-e2e intermittently failed with `page.waitForFunction: Timeout 10000ms exceeded` on loaded CI runners (model-agent-scoping, terminal-embedded), both green on rerun. The 10s deadlines were repo-imposed at the mock Gateway helper and readiness helper, plus twelve per-test setDefaultTimeout sprinkles. Give the harness one owner for the wait budget: 30s under CI, 10s locally, mirroring the ui-e2e vitest config's existing expect.poll reasoning. Suite-created contexts inherit it, so two per-test overrides are deleted outright.
